_README: Lippolis purchasing baseline — what was actually observed.
THIS FILE IS THE ONLY WAY A NUMBER GETS INTO THE BASELINE. Do not edit
proof/baselines/lippolis-purchasing.mjs to add a duration; it reads this.
Every observation needs: minutes, method, observedBy, at, ref.
ref:    what a skeptical reader goes and looks at — a PO number, a file,
a person and a date. '6 minutes' with nothing to check is a memory.
Five timed observations make a step MEASURED. Fewer is capped below it,
however carefully it was timed. One employee estimate among four timings
makes the whole step SELF_REPORTED — the weakest input sets the grade.
appliesToShare: what fraction of purchases this step happens on. Clarification
taking 8 minutes on a quarter of requests contributes 2, not 8.
Everything is empty today, and that is the correct state: nobody has yet
watched how Lippolis bought material before PCC. Empty means UNAVAILABLE,
which makes every value figure downstream read NOT MEASURABLE.

labourRate.note: Fully loaded: wage plus payroll tax, insurance and overhead. From payroll or Paul, in writing. One email; every money figure waits on it.
